item.title: Sister Bay Launches Annual “Goat on a Boat” Contest
item.description: Adam Collins -- The goat is back on Sister Bay, and this year he's riding a brand-new boat.

item.title: Miss Door County Teen leans on personal experience with community initiative
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Before Miss Door County Teen Mia Glocke gained the confidence needed to walk the Southern Door Auditorium stage last month, she had to find it in other facets of her high school life.

item.title: Heart & Sole Program Helps Middle School Girls Build Confidence and Strength
item.description: Adam Collins -- As girls grow up, many face increasing social pressures and mental health challenges. Programs supported by the Wisconsin Office of Children's Mental Health (OCMH) aim to counter those trends by building confidence and resilience early.

item.title: Door County YMCA Announces 2026 “Best Summer Ever” Camp Options
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County YMCA is gearing up for summer with registration now open for its 2026 "Best Summer Ever" youth camps at both the Sturgeon Bay Program Center and the Jackie and Steve Kane Center in Fish Creek.

item.title: High School Job Fair Connects Students with Local Employers Ahead of Hiring Season
item.description: Adam Collins -- Local high school students had the opportunity to explore career paths and employment options during a Job Fair held Wednesday morning at Stone Harbor Resort.

item.title: Miss Door County helps sort through the digital clutter with community initiative
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- With up to 95% of U.S. teens and between 38% and 64% of preteens on social media, Miss Door County Kaylee Griep wants to help them separate the good from the bad.

item.title: Sister Bay Nominated for USA TODAY “Best Small Town in the Midwest”
item.description: Adam Collins -- Sister Bay is celebrating the national spotlight after being nominated for USA TODAY 10Best's "Best Small Town in the Midwest."

item.title: Baileys Harbor woman injured in two-vehicle crash
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A quick look away from the road led to an 86-year-old Baileys Harbor woman being transported to the hospital following a two-vehicle accident Wednesday.

item.title: Soft skills lead the way for employers
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Even if you don't know how to run a CNC machine, fix an HVAC unit or build a house, We Are Hope Inc. Executive Director Kim Carley says there are skills you can bring to a business that every employer can use.

item.title: Kitchens, state legislators look to double down on cell phone ban
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Wisconsin legislators are hopeful their efforts will help your kids keep their hands off their cellphones for a little longer while at school.
